[[File:Wilton Adventures.png|thumb|200px| Wilton in Pokémon Adventures]] '''Wilton''' (Japanese: '''ヒデノリ''' ''Hidenori'') is a {{tc|Fisherman}} and one of the few {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class|ordinary Trainers}} from the games to have also appeared in other media. ==In the games== {{incomplete|section|Pokégear call quotes}} Wilton is found in the [[Generation II]] games and {{game3|HeartGold and SoulSilver|their remakes|s}} on {{rt|44|Johto}}, the path between [[Mahogany Town]] and the [[Ice Path]]. He is one of the many Trainers that the player can register in the [[Pokégear]] for a rematch at a later time, and, in Generation II, he will sometimes call the player to notify them of [[mass {{color2|000|Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions|HeartGold and SoulSilver}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== Wilton is {{adv|Yellow}}'s uncle. ====History==== =====Past===== Wilton was the one who taught Yellow how to fish, and gave Yellow her second Pokémon, {{DL|Yellow (Adventures)|Dody}}. ====={{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}===== Wilton first appeared in ''[[PS039|Just a Spearow Carrier]]'' in [[Indigo Plateau]] when Green attempted to pull a trick on him, by having her {{p|Nidoran♀}} court his {{p|Nidoran♂}} and encourage a trade of her {{p|Weedle}} for his {{p|Butterfree}}. ====={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===== In ''[[PS101|Teddiursa's Picnic]]'' on {{rt|32|Johto}}, where he met {{adv|Gold}}, who asked if he had seen a [[Poké Ball]] containing [[Polibo|a Poliwag]]. Wilton informed Gold that a thief had been stealing Pokémon right out of local Trainers' hands. Gold used his billiards cue to hit the thief in the jaw with a Poké Ball, causing it to fall into the water, and revealing that it was in fact a {{p|Granbull}}. They realized that it had been stealing all the Poké Balls for attention, in order to get help for its jaw, which had conveniently been fixed by Gold's shot. After it gave them back the Poké Balls it had stolen, including Polibo's, Wilton gave Gold his [[Pokégear]] number. Gold then left, and Wilton compared Yellow's fishing skills to Gold’s skill with billiards. Later, in ''[[PS111|Tyranitar War]]'', he went to [[Viridian City]] and told Yellow to go to Johto. Some time after that, in ''[[PS141|Hello, Lickitung]]'', he meets {{adv|Crystal}} after Yellow finds her in [[Olivine City]]. He takes the two girls to the [[Whirl Islands]] soon after. It is here that they encounter {{p|Lugia}} and fight it, but he and Yellow drown and are saved by the [[Day-Care Couple]]. A while later, it was revealed that he, along with Yellow, had gone to [[Ecruteak City]] weeks beforehand, where she lifted the curse that was on the {{adv|Legendary beasts}}. When [[Team Rocket]] attacked the [[Pokémon Day Care]] on {{rt|34|Johto}}, he defended the old couple that owned it and all the Pokémon there. It is also there that he learns of the relation between [[Agatha]], {{adv|Professor Oak}}, the Day-Care Couple, [[Kurt]], and [[Pryce]]. ====={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===== In ''[[PS337|Epilogue]]'', he makes a cameo appearance in one of the ships heading to the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. ====Pokémon==== The following are Wilton's known Pokémon. =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wilton |pkmn=Nidoran♂ |type1=Poison |img=Wilton Nidoran male Adventures.png |epnum=PS039 |epname=Just a Spearow Carrier |desc={{p|Nidoran♂}} was first seen falling in love with {{adv|Green}}'s {{DL|Green (Adventures)|Nido}}. None of Nidoran♂'s moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wilton |pkmn=Butterfree |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Wilton Butterfree Adventures.png |epnum=PS039 |epname=Just a Spearow Carrier |desc={{p|Butterfree}} is Wilton's well known Pokémon. It was first seen with Wilton while {{adv|Green}} asked him to trade it for her {{p|Weedle}}. Wilton uses it for flight transportation. None of Butterfree's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wilton |pkmn=Octillery |type1=Water |img=Wilton Octillery Adventures.png |epnum=PS101 |epname=Teddiursa's Picnic |desc={{p|Octillery}} was one of the Pokémon that was stuck in {{p|Granbull}}'s mouth. None of Octillery's moves are known.}} =====Given away===== {{TrainerPoké |main=Dody |trainer=Wilton |pkmn=Doduo |gender=male |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Yellow Dody Doduo.png |epnum=PS042 |epname=Do Do That Doduo |desc=Wilton gave {{adv|Yellow}} this {{p|Doduo}} as a gift. She nicknamed him Dody, and he later evolved into a {{p|Dodrio}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wilton |pkmn=Remoraid (×20) |type1=Water |img=Gold Remoraid Adventures.png |cap=Wilton's Remoraid |epnum=PS142 |epname=Really Remoraid |desc=Wilton was given these {{p|Remoraid}} from {{adv|Crystal}}, after they had caused a commotion while they were sailing.
